author: Fabse911
quote: Name it grand theft errands or SIMS VI and you have a good title of that game. The story is the worst one of a AAA game in years. Also you can’t steal cars around your neighbourhood in grand theft auto, seriously?!? And the endless restrictions, missing permissions and warnings killing the potential and the vibe of the game. Back then GTA stands for gangster stories, endless crimes and do what you want. The RL aspect and the consequences are good, but the way it is integrated has big downs. And they compensate that with the endless restrictions and limitations. And a game on stable 30FPS is playable, but the game has 30 FPS on good days and the 1% FPS low are around 12FPS. That is stop motion gameplay and bad game optimisation. And beside serious bugs it don’t have auto save options at all, that is like a standard feature since over 20 years in nearly every game, specially all AAA games. Refound and a waste of time.
